cases.technique:
Multiplanar, multisequence MRI of the brain was performed without intravenous contrast.
Sequences acquired: T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI.
cases.findings:
Cerebral Hemispheres:
Normal grey-white matter differentiation.
No focal mass lesion or hemorrhage.

White Matter:
Mild chronic small-vessel ischemic changes involving the deep white matter bilaterally, more prominent in the periventricular regions.
No restricted diffusion.

Basal Ganglia and Thalami:
Normal signal intensity bilaterally.

Ventricular System:
Generalized ventricular enlargement, out of proportion to the patient's age.

Corpus Callosum:
Normal morphology.
Thin body and splenium, consistent with generalized cerebral volume loss.

Midline Structures:
Centered.

Brainstem:
Normal morphology and signal intensity.

Cerebellum:
Normal signal intensity.
Mild cerebellar volume loss.

Extra-axial Spaces:
Prominent cortical sulci, consistent with generalized cerebral volume loss.
No extra-axial collection.

Sellar/Parasellar Region:
Unremarkable.

Orbits:
Normal.

Paranasal Sinuses:
Clear.

Mastoid Air Cells:
Clear.
cases.impression:
1. Mild chronic small-vessel ischemic changes of the deep white matter.
2. Generalized cerebral volume loss, moderate for age.
cases.recommendation: Clinical correlation for vascular risk factor management recommended.

cases.clinicalIndication: Chronic low back pain with left leg radiculopathy
cases.technique:
Multiplanar, multisequence MRI of the lumbosacral spine was performed without intravenous contrast.
Sequences acquired: Sagittal T1, T2, STIR; Axial T2.
cases.findings:
Alignment:
Loss of normal lumbar lordosis.
No spondylolisthesis.

Vertebral Bodies:
Normal heights.
Normal signal intensity.

Bone Marrow:
Normal signal intensity.

Endplates:
Normal.

Intervertebral Discs:
Multilevel disc desiccation from L2-L3 through L5-S1.

L1-L2:
Normal disc height.
No disc bulge or herniation.

L2-L3:
Mild disc desiccation.
No disc bulge or herniation.

L3-L4:
Moderate disc desiccation.
No disc bulge or herniation.

L4-L5:
Moderate disc desiccation.
Diffuse disc bulge causing mild thecal sac indentation.
No significant neural foraminal narrowing.

L5-S1:
Severe disc desiccation.
Posterior disc protrusion measuring approximately 4 mm in AP dimension.
Moderate left neural foraminal narrowing with contact of the left L5 nerve root.
Mild right neural foraminal narrowing.

Posterior Elements:
Normal.

Ligamentum Flavum:
Normal thickness.

Facet Joints:
Mild facet arthropathy at L4-L5 and L5-S1 bilaterally.
Normal at other levels.

Spinal Canal:
Normal caliber at upper lumbar levels.
Mild narrowing at L4-L5 and L5-S1.

Neural Foramina:
Patent at L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L4 bilaterally.
Mild right narrowing at L5-S1.
Moderate left narrowing at L5-S1.

Conus Medullaris:
Terminates at L1 level.
Normal signal intensity.

Cauda Equina:
Normal.

Paravertebral Soft Tissues:
Unremarkable.

Canal AP Measurements:
| Level | AP Diameter |
|-------|-------------|
| L1-L2 | 14.5 mm |
| L2-L3 | 13.8 mm |
| L3-L4 | 13.2 mm |
| L4-L5 | 12.0 mm |
| L5-S1 | 11.5 mm |
cases.impression:
1. Loss of lumbar lordosis.
2. Multilevel lumbar disc desiccation.
3. L4-L5 diffuse disc bulge with mild thecal sac indentation.
4. L5-S1 posterior disc protrusion with moderate left neural foraminal narrowing and left L5 nerve root contact.
5. Mild facet arthropathy at L4-L5 and L5-S1.
cases.recommendation: Clinical correlation for left L5 radiculopathy. Consider targeted epidural steroid injection if conservative management fails.
